compasstri.screen.title: Compass Triangulator
compasstri.screen.hud.tooltip: A small panel while you hold a compass, or while there are readings: where the compass points and where the readings meet.
compasstri.screen.auto.tooltip: While you hold a lodestone compass whose target the game knows, take a reading each time you have walked the distance below from every earlier reading. If the target keeps changing (a stand-in point that follows you), stand still for a moment instead.
compasstri.screen.source.tooltip: Compass data: the exact direction to the target the compass holds, if it holds one. Where I look: line the needle up so it points straight up, then record. Use that if a server draws its own compass needle.
compasstri.screen.min_distance.tooltip: How far to walk between automatic readings. Far apart and from the side gives a sharper estimate.
compasstri.screen.angle_error.tooltip: How exactly you line up the needle when you record a reading by looking. Used to weigh the readings and to work out the error margin.
compasstri.screen.reset.title: Put the settings back to their defaults?
compasstri.hud.title: Compass Triangulator
compasstri.hud.moving: Target moves: stand still to read
compasstri.hud.need_more: One more, from off to the side
compasstri.tooltip.hint_unbound: Bind "Record a reading" in Controls to record from here
compasstri.tooltip.waypoint_unbound: Bind "Add as Xaero waypoint" to save "%s"
compasstri.tooltip.need_more: %s reading(s): teleport away and record again
compasstri.msg.hover_first: Point at a lodestone compass first
compasstri.msg.no_target_here: That compass has no target in this dimension
compasstri.msg.waypoint_not_ready: Xaero's Minimap is not ready yet (join a world first)
compasstri.msg.waypoint_failed: Could not add the waypoint (see the log)
compasstri.msg.waypoint_nothing: Nothing to save: no estimate yet and no compass with a target in your hand
